name: Apex Space
description: Apex Space is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Apex Space is a privately held spacecraft manufacturer. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $200 million Series E round announced on June 5, 2026, valued the company at $2.3 billion.

Based in Los Angeles, Apex Space builds satellite buses, the standard spacecraft platforms on which customers mount their own instruments and equipment, for commercial and government constellations. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Apex Space
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company.
round_notes: Apex Space announced the June 2026 financing as growth funding without a series designation; its legal counsel has since described it as a Series E. With the announcement, the company said it would expand its Factory One campus in Los Angeles by 30,000 square feet.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Glade Brook Capital Partners led the Series E, with Washington Harbour Partners as co-lead. Interlagos led the Series D, Point72 Ventures and 8VC led the Series C, XYZ Venture Capital and CRV led the Series B, and Andreessen Horowitz and Shield Capital co-led the Series A. Other investors include StepStone Group, Toyota Ventures, Upfront Ventures and J2 Ventures.
spv_sentence: In 2026, seven special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Apex Space filed with the SEC, all of them series of Augurey Ventures funds.
sources: Sources: Apex's June 2026 funding announcement; Greenberg Traurig's announcement (June 22, 2026); reports by Payload (June 2026 and April 2025), Bloomberg (September 2025), Via Satellite (September 2025) and TechCrunch (June 2024 and June 2023); and SEC Form D filings.
